subtitle: Automatically transform an article into blog posts and presentation slides across three languages.
sourceHint: Share a post URL, a .md file, or your document.
dropHint: or drop a file anywhere on this card
slideHint: Choose the slide length to create Google Slides in your configured Google Drive.
formFoot: The posts take a few minutes. Slides take longer the longer the talk, and you can review the posts meanwhile. Nothing is posted before you approve it.
askTitle: Ask the agent for a change
askPlaceholder: Ask the agent for a change (e.g. replace examples, adjust tone)...
settingsHint: Blog platforms per language and Google Slides integration status.
settingsNoteText: Credentials stay on the server; this page never sees them.
langSettingHint: Choose the display language for this web page.
promptsModalHint: Click a prompt to fill the box, edit if needed, and press Send.
noHistoryText: Nothing you typed has been sent yet.
sourcesModalHint: Runs on this server, newest first. Click an entry to fill the source box, or open its run.
noSourceHistoryText: No runs on this server yet.
prompt.retranslate: Re-translate the updated source article into the other two languages
prompt.informal_intro: Make the Korean intro less formal
reviewHint: Review {file} and edit it if needed. Finalize it when it is ready.
reviewHintDrafted: The title or text changed after the draft was made. Finalize it to update the post.
postHint: Finalized. You choose tags and draft or public when you approve.
pasteHint: Finalized. Paste naver_blog.html into the Naver editor, post, then register the URL.
olderThanSourceTitle: The source article was edited after this post was translated from it.
oneAnswerAtATime: The agent takes one answer at a time: answering this one declines the others.
agentWorkingRetry: The agent is still working. Try again when it has finished.
lostContact: Lost contact with the server. Trying again…
runGone: That run is not on this server any more. Its files remain in the workspace folder.
pasteFirst: Paste a URL or a draft first.
tagRule.qiita: Qiita takes one to five tags without spaces, separated by commas.
tagRule.devto: DEV Community takes up to four tags, lowercase letters and digits only, separated by commas.
visibility.draftHint: Not public. You publish it yourself on the site.
visibility.publicHint: Visible to everyone as soon as you approve.
postNote: This uses your account on that platform.
credentialsTitle: The {language} text has values that look like credentials
credentialsNote: {count} in all. Remove them in the editor if they are real. If they are examples, you can finalize anyway.
credentialsNoteMany: {count} in all, the first 40 shown. Remove them in the editor if they are real. If they are examples, you can finalize anyway.
finalizedDiffers: Finalized. Note: its structure differs from the source: {errors}
enterUrl: Enter the https URL of the post.
driveOf: a new file in the Google Drive of {account}
driveYours: a new file in your Google Drive
slidesPlanReplaced: there is a plan already; what was changed in its speaker notes is replaced by the new plan
slidesDeckKept: there is a deck already; a new file is made and the earlier deck stays in Drive
slidesTitle: Make {language} slides and a Google Slides deck?
slidesAgainTitle: Make the {language} slides and deck again?
deckContainsValue: one slide per minute, script in the speaker notes
attachWrongType: Attach a Markdown (.md) or text file.
attachTooLarge: The file is larger than 80 KB, the limit for one article.
replaceBoxTitle: Replace what is in the box?
fileLoaded: {name} loaded ({count} characters). You can edit it above.
fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
settingsUnreadable: The settings could not be read: {error}
slideName.title: title slide
editor.badAddress: This address does not name a file that can be edited.
editor.postLocked: This post can no longer be edited here: it is already public, or its file is left from an earlier text. Edit a public post on its site.
editor.fileLocked: This file cannot be edited here.
editor.savingPost: Saving replaces the text the agent will post.
editor.savingPlanWithDeck: Saving changes this file. You are then asked whether to update the Google Slides deck.
editor.savingPlanNoDeck: Saving changes this file. There is no Google Slides deck for this language yet.
editor.postMatches: Structure matches the source. Finalize the post on the main page before posting it.
editor.postDiffers: Differs from the source: {errors} Finalize the post on the main page before posting it.
editor.planBroken: It no longer reads as a slide plan, so the deck cannot be updated from it: {errors}
editor.hasSecrets: It has values that look like credentials; you will be asked about them when you finalize.
editor.deckSame: The deck already has this text. Nothing to update.
editor.pushConflicts: Also edited in the deck: {slides}. Approving replaces that text with this file's; pull from the deck first to keep it.
editor.noBaselinePush: There is no record of what the deck last held, so every difference is taken from this file.
editor.onlyInFile: Not in the deck, so skipped: {slides}.
editor.changedSincePreview: The deck or the file changed after you were asked. Nothing was written; try again.
editor.saveBeforePull: Save or cancel your changes before pulling from the deck.
editor.pullNothing: Nothing was edited in the deck. The file is unchanged.
editor.pullConflicts: Also edited in this file: {slides}. Approving replaces that text with the deck's.
editor.noBaselinePull: There is no record of what the deck last held, so every difference is taken from the deck.
editor.pullTitle: Bring the deck's text into this file?
editor.fileUpdated.one: File updated from the deck: {n} slide.
editor.fileUpdated.other: File updated from the deck: {n} slides.
